_doc: Policy-driven normalize spec injected into visualbind.Normalizer. Each column is one scalar signal that the worker pipeline publishes (after structuring); the worker maps the raw value into a per-column [-1, 1] / (sin, cos) coordinate so statistics accumulators can treat every column on the same scale. Plugin-derived columns carry a 'mediapipe__' / 'head_pose__' prefix to keep the source explicit — the two head-pose estimators are complementary (MediaPipe = frontal mesh precision; 6DRepNet = side-angle robustness) and both feed signal_statistics; downstream selectors / appearance_statistics decide which source to weight per task.
